name: VolumeSegmenter Pipeline
definition: An end-to-end pipeline that filters large RAW volumes into compact, spatially mapped bricks, organizes them into selectable logical groups based on intensity and adjacency, and renders them in WebGL2. It reduces stored and GPU-resident voxel data but may increase rendering time due to sparse lookup and ray-marching overhead.
summary: The VolumeSegmenter Pipeline compresses volumetric data into intensity-band groups for efficient WebGL2 rendering, differing from spatial partitioning by grouping bricks via intensity and adjacency.
